title: Re-cite workspace after spec BCP 14 keyword sweep
description: jmap-chat-spec 4ffb96e ('downgrade overstrong BCP 14 keywords', 2026-10-31) and follow-ups (0a43b97, cfd3d95, 89eccb0, 77c3474) changed ~89 normative lines in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md and ~29 in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-federation-00.md, mostly MUST -> SHOULD (e.g. senderExpiresAt/burnOnRead/expiresAfterReadSeconds hard-delete; Space/destroy manage_space). Docs, CHANGELOG and test comments across the workspace still quote the old keywords (known: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/backend.rs ~L1186, tests/message_burn_on_read_atomic.rs:5; testkit.rs already fixed in d764cc1f). Two parts: (1) behaviour audit: for each changed requirement, check whether any crate now REJECTS something the spec permits (a MUST-reject that became SHOULD/MAY, or a MUST NOT that became SHOULD NOT) and list those for Mark's decision; stricter behaviour that the spec only recommends is fine and is documented as this crate's choice; (2) re-cite every quote of a changed sentence against the then-current spec head. Do before the 0.5.0 release so its docs are accurate.
notes:
z4z0.7 behaviour audit (jmap-chat-spec 77c3474; sweep 4ffb96e..77c3474). Report only, no code changed.
RESULT: no crate rejects, refuses or errors on anything the sweep now permits. Every keyword change relaxes an obligation on the implementing server (MUST->SHOULD/MAY, MUST NOT->SHOULD NOT) or turns a client rule into prose. In each case the crate already does the recommended behaviour, which is still conformant. Rules now on the other party (client or peer) are not enforced by any receiver here: MessageAction metadata is an untyped Value (chat-types message.rs:374); ChatStreamEnable.id is optional (chat-types ephemeral.rs:73); push kinds/chatIds are matched, never checked for consistency (chat-server push.rs:525); scene has no viewHint/geoAnchor check. Checked remaining MUSTs inside changed sentences: no case found where code does LESS (past senderExpiresAt rejected message.rs:1587; Space/join notPermitted space.rs:1813; expired/exhausted invite invalidArguments space.rs:1767/1883; maxKeyPackages overQuota mimi backend.rs:176; VTC supports*Calls forbidden call.rs:347-351; ring answer requires callResponse pending participant.rs:761; Peer/deliver encrypted skips 11-13 deliver.rs:1252).
Format: spec sentence (77c3474 Lnnn, old -> new) | crate file:line | current behaviour | options | recommendation
1. chat L1391 Space destroy: caller MUST->SHOULD hold manage_space; forbidden MUST->SHOULD | chat-server backend.rs:824 (trait contract), memory.rs:1388 | backend contract makes manage_space mandatory; a deployment can add requirements but cannot replace manage_space with e.g. a dedicated controller principal | (a) keep; (b) relax the contract to "SHOULD, or the deployment's own rule" | (a) keep. Custom backends own destroy_object anyway; the docs now say this is the crate's choice.
2. fed L356/L400 peer-role forbidden MUST->SHOULD | federation-server lib.rs:83-85 dispatcher guard; deliver.rs:109 | always forbidden, no opt-out | keep / make configurable | keep (security boundary).
3. chat L747/L750/L753 senderExpiresAt, burnOnRead, expiresAfterReadSeconds hard-delete MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:2237 (read_and_burn_message), backend.rs expire_message | always deletes; burn is atomic with readAt | keep / allow opt-out | keep (privacy feature the sender asked for).
4. chat L1218/L1220 sender membership and send permission MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:1463 may_send_message (overridable ChatBackend hook) | enforced; backend can override | none needed | keep.
5. chat L1301 view permission/omission MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:150, memory.rs:1103 (may_view_chat hook) | enforced; overridable | keep.
6. chat L462 broadcast mention forbidden MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:1488 (may_broadcast_mention hook) | enforced; overridable | keep.
7. chat L623 slow mode rateLimit MUST->SHOULD; manage_channels exemption SHOULD->MAY | chat-server message.rs:1663 slow_mode_check hook | backend decides | keep.
8. chat L374 attachment size verify MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:868 attachment_blob | verified when the backend returns a blob | keep.
9. chat L1823 / fed L532 encrypted bodyType field rejection MUST->SHOULD | chat-server message.rs:685,1350; federation-server deliver.rs:1254 | rejected, no opt-out | keep (keeps routing metadata out of E2EE messages).
10. chat L1164 Chat/typing invalidArguments MUST->SHOULD | chat-server chat.rs:1641 | rejected, cases not distinguished | keep.
11. chat L1416 invite uses+membership atomic MUST->SHOULD | chat-server space.rs (join_space_with_invite), backend.rs:1146 contract | atomic required of backends | keep (prevents exceeding maxUses).
12. chat L1420 SpaceBan check MUST->SHOULD | chat-server space.rs:1847 | enforced in handler, no opt-out | keep.
13. chat L1355 removeRoles override cleanup SHOULD->MAY | chat-server memory.rs:4050 | MemoryBackend removes them | keep.
14. chat L1317/L1318 Space/get extra fields omitted / notFound MUST->SHOULD | chat-server space.rs (restricted view) | omitted / notFound | keep (privacy).
15. chat L1478 CustomEmoji forbidden MUST->SHOULD | chat-server (custom emoji auth hook) | forbidden when hook denies | keep.
16. chat L649 receiveTypingIndicators drop MUST->SHOULD; channel MUST NOT->SHOULD NOT suppress | chat-server ephemeral.rs:247; federation-server typing.rs:78 | drop for direct/group only; channels never suppressed | keep.
17. fed L782 Peer/typing forward MUST->SHOULD | federation-server typing.rs:78 | forwards | keep.
18. fed L850 Peer/retract sender check MUST->SHOULD | federation-server retract.rs | forbidden on mismatch | keep (security).
19. fed L948 Peer/groupUpdate admin/member checks MUST->SHOULD | federation-server group_update.rs:40 (doc), 66 | forbidden | keep (security).
20. mimi L204 duplicate KeyPackageRef reject MUST->SHOULD | chat-mimi-server backend.rs:170 | rejected | keep.
21. filenode L143 root permission forbidden MUST->SHOULD | chat-filenode-server lib.rs:145 | forbidden | keep.
22. push L214 SHOULD NOT deliver ChatMessagePush (was MUST NOT) | chat-server push.rs (should_push) | not delivered | keep.
23. scene L2776 reserved display names SHOULD/SHOULD->MAY/MAY | scene-server avatar.rs:342 (reserved_display_names hook) | rejects names the backend lists | keep.
24. scene-wss L917 / vtc-wss L413 duplicate events MUST NOT->SHOULD NOT | chat-scene-server lib.rs:43, chat-vtc-server lib.rs:538 | sent once | keep.
25. vtc L815/L844/L877 mayCreateCall=false forbidden MUST->SHOULD | vtc-server call.rs:343 | forbidden | keep.
26. vtc L1147 last moderator self-revoke SHOULD NOT/SHOULD reject (was MUST) | vtc-server participant.rs:880 | forbidden | keep.
27. vtc L1217 VTCParticipant/query callId SHOULD->MAY require | vtc-server participant.rs:149 | unsupportedFilter without callId/userId (spec: MAY be rejected) | keep.
28. vtc L1819 ring timeout "RECOMMENDED: 30 seconds" -> "for example, 30 seconds" | vtc-server call.rs:792 RING_TIMEOUT default, overridable VtcBackend::ring_timeout | 30 s default | keep.
Stale quotes found that the sweep did NOT change (left alone, per task): chat-server tests/single_user_owner_gates.rs:92 and tests/space_create_bootstrap_admin.rs:129 quote "servers MUST enforce this" (spec says SHOULD both before and after the sweep); tests/typing_delivery.rs:4 and :161 quote wss:250 wording that 77c3474 no longer has; tests/message_broadcast_permission_memory.rs:105 quotes a §Message/set "A create request ..." sentence absent at both 4ffb96e~1 and 77c3474. Released CHANGELOG sections (L535, L3016, L4197, L4494) quote old wording and were left as history.
close_reason: Batch 37: d8d20b52..f4c6b688 (~120 re-citations in 12 crates against jmap-chat-spec 77c3474, comment-only, public-api unchanged); behaviour audit (28 items) found nothing rejecting what the spec now permits, all keep; local CI all green (6740 tests stable+beta).
